faqs.question: When is the best season for a Lonavala wedding?
faqs.answer: October to February brings clear skies and pleasant weather. Monsoon weddings look stunningly green but need covered backups for rituals and portraits — we plan for both.

faqs.question: Do you charge extra to travel to Lonavala?
faqs.answer: Lonavala is a short drive from Mumbai. Travel and any overnight stay for the crew are listed clearly in your quote before you book.

faqs.answer: Yes. For multi-day weddings the crew stays nearby so early haldi and late reception coverage both work. Stay costs are listed in your quote.

faqs.question: Can we have a monsoon wedding in Mahabaleshwar?
faqs.answer: Mahabaleshwar gets very heavy rain from June to September and many points close. Most couples choose October to May; we'll help you plan around the weather either way.

faqs.question: How long should the crew be booked for a hill-station wedding?
faqs.answer: For a two-day wedding, most couples book the crew from the first function to the reception, with travel the day before. Your quote will set this out clearly.

faqs.answer: November to February has the most reliable weather. Many beach venues limit outdoor events during the monsoon, roughly June to September.

faqs.answer: Many do, and rules vary by venue. Ask your planner early — we'll build the shoot timeline around those limits so sunset portraits and the pheras or vows aren't rushed.

faqs.question: Do palace venues allow drones?
faqs.answer: Drone use depends on the venue and local rules. We check permissions with your planner before including drone coverage.
